nodes.label: User-invoked vs model-invoked split
nodes.rationale: User-invoked skills are reachable only by the human (disable-model-invocation + policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false) with human-facing descriptions stripped of trigger lists; model-invoked skills keep rich trigger phrasing. A user-invoked skill may invoke model-invoked skills, never another user-invoked one.

nodes.label: Prose-invocation dependencies
nodes.rationale: Dependencies are expressed as /skill-style prose invocation, not deep cross-folder file links; shared reference docs live inside the owning skill and others reach them by invoking the skill.
